AquaSense

Data Deletion Instructions

Last updated: October 22, 2026

Signed-in AquaSense users can request deletion from the application. Open Settings → Security & Privacy → Delete My Account, confirm your account email, complete the identity check, and submit the request.

  1. Email/password users must provide their current password. Google and Facebook users must have signed in recently; if prompted, sign out and sign in again first.
  2. The request removes the account's owned aquariums, sensor readings, aquarium settings, alerts, care tasks, health reports, preferences, and AquaSense authentication account. It does not delete your Google or Facebook account.
  3. Administrator accounts are protected from self-service deletion. Contact the administrator who manages the platform to request administrator-account or other assistance.

Deletion is permanent and cannot be undone. The server verifies the signed-in account and removes only records associated with its aquarium ownership. If an unrecognized database dependency prevents safe cleanup, the request fails and the account is not reported as deleted. A failure after aquarium cleanup but before authentication-account removal requires the user to retry or contact the administrator.

Information may remain temporarily in service-provider backups or be retained where required for security or legal reasons. For details about information AquaSense uses, read the Privacy Policy.
